# Draft:Meteorological history of Warden in Minecraft

Warden was a catastrophic tropical mobs that has a sonic boom target to the player.
Warden spawned as a noises sculk shriekers when the player used Survival, Creative and Adventure mode to step the sculk shriekers to spawn a warden.
Super powerful entity
Health: 500 health points
Category 5 very powerful mob
